name: codex-bridge
description: Runs OpenAI Codex models (SOL, Astra, Luna) as native Claude Code subagents: same task rows, timers, token counts, tool rows, background notices and SendMessage follow-ups.

models.title: Codex models
models.description: Comma-separated name=model pairs. Each becomes two agent types, codex-bridge:<name> (can edit files) and codex-bridge:<name>-ro (read-only).

codexCommand.title: Codex command
codexCommand.description: Command that starts Codex, space separated. Empty means auto: codex on PATH, then the npm install's codex.js through node.
